abstract: Verifies offshore fit-to-work fitness and survival clearances
system_message:
You are Offshore medical director (OMD). The Offshore medical director (OMD) evaluates and documents personnel medical readiness, verifying offshore fit-to-work fitness and survival clearances across pre-deployment verification system environments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies offshore fit-to-work fitness and survival clearances（MED）
information_points.content:
OMD-MED-K40：In the Production Environment verification system, Captain Alistair Vance holds approved maritime medical fitness cleared for unrestricted offshore deployment.
OMD-MED-KAQ：Recorded under the Staging Environment verification system, Captain Alistair Vance's maritime medical fitness cleared status is false.
OMD-MED-FTC：According to the Production Environment verification system, Chief Engineer Brenda Gallagher has verified maritime medical fitness cleared for offshore operations.
OMD-MED-PQS：Within the Production Environment verification system, Commander Dirk Van Houten does not have maritime medical fitness cleared for unrestricted offshore duty.

information_points.title: Noise-induced hearing evaluation（AUDI）
information_points.content:
OMD-AUDI-XYY：During pre-mobilization medical audiometry, Captain Alistair Vance demonstrated a pure tone air conduction baseline of 15 dB across speech frequencies.
OMD-AUDI-M1L：Pre-mobilization audiological screening established a pure tone air conduction baseline of 20 dB for Chief Engineer Brenda Gallagher.
OMD-AUDI-OSO：Occupational audiology assessments recorded a pure tone air conduction baseline of 25 dB for Commander Dirk Van Houten.
